nodes.label: Detection over Configuration
nodes.rationale: PHP versions and installed services are auto-detected instead of configured, reducing setup drift.

nodes.label: Root-of-Truth Layering (JS→api→svc→store)
nodes.rationale: API handlers must never exec or write /etc directly; system side effects belong in internal/svc, persistence in internal/store. Keeps system mutation auditable and testable.

nodes.label: One Language, One Binary (go:embed frontend)
nodes.rationale: Whole panel — API, frontend, customer web server — ships as a single Go binary; embed removes build/deploy split.
